pending-clause.answer: The flag fires on 'TERMINATE' (the report-writer statement). The rule is about that statement leaving the report file open; it does not rest on §2002:14.5.10 run unit termination, whose implicit CLOSE of open files (item 1) is word-equivalent to 2023's (2023 adds only an implicit COMMIT and dynamic-storage freeing), nor on initial state or transfers of control. Scope and the l1c33_terminate_multi_order_no_close evidence at 2002 are unchanged.
